title: Ethiopia's government, led by Prime Minister Meles Zenawi, prioritizes food security, especially in light of past famines. The current approach emphasizes linking food aid to development, requiring able-bodied individuals to work for food instead of receiving free handouts. This strategy aims to build confidence and reduce dependency. Projects like the Maileba dam are designed to improve agricultural productivity and water access for farmers. The government has implemented early warning systems to predict crop failures and has established a national food reserve to respond quickly to food shortages. Overall, the focus is on sustainable solutions to prevent famine and ensure food security for the population.
